text:
No, unfortunately we can't ship a monstera to a PO box. PO boxes are for non-living items only, and live plants can't be delivered to them. Express speed doesn't change that.

If you have a street address (home, work, or a friend's), we can ship there. Express is $14.95 and is available in Zones 1 and 2 (next business day in Zone 1, 2 business days in Zone 2), but not in Zone 3. Live plants ship Monday–Wednesday only, so orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the following Monday.
